pmid_database.title: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, enriched-design study of nabiximols* (Sativex), as add-on therapy, in subjects with refractory spasticity caused by multiple sclerosis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Phase 3 enriched-design RCT of Sativex (nabiximols) for MS spasticity. 241 randomized; highly significant improvement in spasticity NRS (P=0.0002) in favour of nabiximols. Secondary endpoints including spasm frequency and sleep disturbance all significant.

pmid_database.title: Cannabidiol enhances anandamide signaling and alleviates psychotic symptoms of schizophrenia.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Double-blind RCT comparing CBD vs amisulpride in acute schizophrenia. Both produced significant clinical improvement. CBD had superior side-effect profile and elevated anandamide levels, significantly associated with clinical improvement.

pmid_database.title: Efficacy and Safety of Cannabidiol and Tetrahydrocannabivarin on Glycemic and Lipid Parameters in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel Group Pilot Study.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: RCT in 62 T2 diabetes patients. THCV significantly decreased fasting plasma glucose and improved beta-cell function and adiponectin. CBD decreased resistin and increased GIP vs baseline. CBD and THCV were well tolerated.

pmid_database.title: Clinical endocannabinoid deficiency (CECD) revisited: can this concept explain the therapeutic benefits of cannabis in migraine, fibromyalgia, irritable bowel syndrome and other treatment-resistant conditions?
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of CECD (clinical endocannabinoid deficiency) concept for migraine, fibromyalgia, IBS, and other treatment-resistant conditions. Evidence supports endocannabinoid deficiencies in these conditions. Cannabis blocks spinal, peripheral, and gastrointestinal pain mechanisms.

pmid_database.title: A Systematic Review of the Clinical Effects of Cannabis and Cannabinoids in Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Symptoms and Symptom Clusters.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 14 studies reviewed. 5/10 suggested benefits on overall PTSD symptoms; some benefits on hyperarousal/re-experiencing clusters. Individuals with comorbid CUD at greater risk of worsening. Insufficient evidence to recommend broadly.

pmid_database.title: Cannabinoids, Insomnia, and Other Sleep Disorders.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Critical review of cannabinoids (THC, CBD, CBN) for sleep disorders including insomnia and sleep apnea. ECS modulates circadian sleep-wake cycle. Most studies limited by small sample size and bias. Strong rationale for continued investigation.

pmid_database.title: Does medicinal cannabis affect depression, anxiety, and stress in people with cancer? A systematic review and meta-analysis of intervention studies.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 15 studies, 1898 participants. Cannabis significantly improved appetite in cancer patients (OR 12.3). No clinically significant effect on depression/anxiety. Higher-dose THC increased anxiety risk. Insufficient evidence for mood outcomes.

pmid_database.title: Cannabis for the treatment of Crohn's disease.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Cochrane review. 3 RCTs, 93 participants. THC cannabis showed clinical response advantage over placebo (91% vs 40%). CBD oil showed no difference in remission. Effects uncertain due to small sizes and very low evidence certainty.

pmid_database.title: Cannabis and adverse cardiovascular events: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 20 studies, 183M patients. Cannabis use not significantly associated with acute MI (OR 1.29) or stroke (OR 1.35). Caution warranted due to study heterogeneity. Current evidence does not demonstrate significantly increased CV risk.

pmid_database.title: Medical cannabis and mental health: A guided systematic review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 31 studies reviewed. Preliminary evidence supports CTP for PTSD and as substitute for substance misuse. Psychotic disorders may worsen. Cognitive assessment may be affected acutely. CTP does not increase self-harm risk.

pmid_database.title: Cannabis Improves Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder—Case Report and Review of the Literature.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Case report + literature review. THC (dronabinol) improved OCD symptoms. Small open trial: nabilone + exposure therapy superior to monotherapy. Case presented: severe OCD markedly improved with medicinal cannabis, quality of life improved.

pmid_database.title: Early evidence of the impact of cannabis legalization on cannabis use, cannabis use disorder, and the use of other substances: Findings from state policy evaluations.
pmid_database.journal: The American Journal of Drug and Alcohol Abuse
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Narrative review of quasi-experimental studies on state MCLs and RCLs. MCLs increase adult but not adolescent cannabis use. May reduce opioid harms. RCLs show little impact on adolescent prevalence. Impacts on alcohol/tobacco uncertain.

pmid_database.title: The impact of cannabis use on vasomotor symptoms, mood, insomnia and sexuality in perimenopausal and postmenopausal women: a systematic review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 3 studies met inclusion criteria. Cannabis use associated with hot flashes in HIV+ menopausal women. Women expected cannabis to improve depression, anxiety, hot flashes, sleep. Very limited evidence base — research urgently needed.

pmid_database.title: Cannabinoids and Cytochrome P450 Interactions.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of cannabinoid-CYP450 interactions. CBD is the most potent CYP inhibitor. CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4 catalyze phytocannabinoid hydroxylation. Drug-drug interactions documented but clinical relevance unclear.

pmid_database.title: Cannabinol and Sleep: Separating Fact from Fiction.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Narrative review of CBN and sleep. 8 studies reviewed. No clinical trials measuring CBN vs validated sleep questionnaires found. Insufficient evidence to support sleep-related claims. Doses in products typically too low. CBN sleep claims unsubstantiated.

pmid_database.title: Altered Neurobehavioral Reward Response Predicts Psychotic-Like Experiences in Youth Exposed to Cannabis Prenatally.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: ABCD Study, 11,368 children. Prenatal cannabis exposure longitudinally associated with psychotic-like experiences. Blunted striatal reward response mediates PCE-psychosis link. Dopaminergic disruption implicated.

pmid_database.title: Adverse events associated with the use of cannabis-based products in people living with cancer: a systematic scoping review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 152 studies including 61 RCTs. Primarily GI, liver/peritoneal and haematological cancers. Most common adverse events: nervous system (118), psychiatric (101), GI (81). CBP mainly oral or inhaled THC/CBD combinations. Under-reporting noted.

pmid_database.title: Consensus recommendations on dosing and administration of medical cannabis to treat chronic pain: results of a modified Delphi process.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 20 global experts, 9 countries, modified Delphi consensus. Three dosing protocols (routine, conservative, rapid) established. CBD-predominant start, titrate to goals, then add THC if needed. Max 40 mg/day THC. Applicable to neuropathic, inflammatory, nociplastic, mixed pain.

pmid_database.title: Cannabinoid signaling and liver therapeutics.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of ECS in liver disease. CB1 antagonists show antifibrogenic and metabolic benefits; brain-penetrant rimonabant withdrawn due to mood effects. Peripherally-restricted CB1 antagonists validated in NAFLD preclinical models. CB2 is anti-inflammatory/antifibrogenic target.

pmid_database.title: The Pharmacological Case for Cannabigerol.
pmid_database.journal: Journal of Pharmacology and Experimental Therapeutics
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of CBG pharmacology. Unique interactions with alpha-2 adrenoceptors and 5-HT. Potential for Huntington's, Parkinson's, MS, IBD, antibacterial. Little research compared to CBD. Marketed as dietary supplement. Toxicological hazards underdefined.

pmid_database.title: Association of Cannabis With Cognitive Functioning in Adolescents and Young Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 69 studies, 2152 cannabis users. Small overall effect on cognition (d=-0.25). Abstinence >72 hours reduced effect to non-significant (d=-0.08). Previous studies may have overstated deficits. Deficits may reflect residual/withdrawal effects.

pmid_database.title: Effects of cannabidiol and delta-tetrahydrocannabinol on cytochrome P450 enzymes: a systematic review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 7 studies. Both CBD and THC inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C19, CYP2B6. Inhibitory effects may decrease metabolism of psychotropic medications and increase adverse effects. High risk of DDIs for patients using both cannabis and psychotropic drugs. Induction understudied.

pmid_database.title: Cannabidiol for the Reduction of Cue-Induced Craving and Anxiety in Drug-Abstinent Individuals With Heroin Use Disorder: A Double-Blind Randomized Placebo-Controlled Trial.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: CBD (400/800 mg) significantly reduced cue-induced craving and anxiety vs placebo in heroin use disorder. Effects sustained 7 days after last dose. Reduced heart rate and cortisol. No cognitive effects. No serious adverse effects.

pmid_database.title: Brief Report: Cannabidiol-Rich Cannabis in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder and Severe Behavioral Problems—A Retrospective Feasibility Study.
pmid_database.journal: Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 60 ASD children. 61% showed behavioral outbreaks much improved or very much improved. AEs: sleep disturbances 14%, irritability 9%, loss of appetite 9%. One serious psychotic event with high-THC product. Supports feasibility of CBD-based trials in ASD.

pmid_database.title: Epidemiological characteristics, safety and efficacy of medical cannabis in the elderly.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 2736 patients >65 years. Pain reduced from median 8 to 4/10 after 6 months. 93.7% reported condition improvement. 18.1% reduced or stopped opioids. Main AEs: dizziness 9.7%, dry mouth 7.1%. Cannabis safe and efficacious in elderly.

pmid_database.title: Cannabidiol for the Management of Endometriosis and Chronic Pelvic Pain.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of cannabis-based products for endometriosis. Most evidence from preclinical models. Survey studies affected by bias. Cannot recommend CBD/cannabis in UK due to insufficient evidence. More human trials urgently needed.

pmid_database.title: The use of a synthetic cannabinoid in the management of treatment-resistant nightmares in posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 47 PTSD patients with treatment-resistant nightmares. 72% experienced cessation or significant reduction in nightmares after nabilone. Subjective improvements in sleep time and quality. First report of nabilone for PTSD nightmares.

pmid_database.title: Cannabis and Inflammation in HIV: A Review of Human and Animal Studies.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Cannabinoids anti-inflammatory in HIV. Anti-inflammatory actions mediated through ECS in gut and gut-blood barrier stabilization. CBD particularly important as anti-inflammatory. Cannabis may reduce morbidity from inflammation in PWH.

pmid_database.title: The Long-Term, Prospective, Therapeutic Impact of Cannabis on Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 150 participants, 1-year prospective study. Cannabis users showed greater decrease in PTSD severity over time. 2.57x more likely to no longer meet DSM-5 PTSD criteria vs non-users. Dispensary cannabis shows promise as alternative treatment.

pmid_database.title: Positive expectations predict improved mental-health outcomes linked to psychedelic microdosing.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 81 participants, 4-week microdosing study. Improved wellbeing, reduced anxiety and depression reported. However, positive expectancy scores predicted improvements — significant placebo response identified. Cautions against overstating therapeutic value of microdosing.

pmid_database.title: Psychedelics as an intervention for psychological, existential distress in terminally ill patients: A systematic review and network meta-analysis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 9 RCTs, 606 participants. Psychedelics effective for depression (SMD -0.80) and anxiety (SMD -0.84) in terminal illness. Psilocybin best for depression; LSD best for anxiety. Tolerability comparable to controls. Blinding limitations noted.

pmid_database.title: Cannabis effects on driving skills.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Epidemiologic: ~2x increased MVA risk after cannabis smoking. Blood THC 2-5 ng/mL associated with substantial impairment in occasional smokers. Cannabis increases lane weaving, impairs cognition, reaction time. Combining with alcohol enhances impairment.

pmid_database.title: Quality Traits of 'Cannabidiol Oils': Cannabinoids Content, Terpene Fingerprint and Oxidation Stability of European Commercially Available Preparations.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 14 commercial European CBD oils tested. 9/14 had cannabinoid concentrations differing notably from declared amount. Wide variability in cannabinoid profiles. Terpene fingerprint as quality indicator. Strict standardized regulations needed.

pmid_database.title: Antioxidative and Anti-Inflammatory Properties of Cannabidiol.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of CBD's antioxidative and anti-inflammatory properties. Multiple molecular targets including cannabinoid receptors, ECS components. Preclinical and clinical evidence for therapeutic potential in oxidative stress-associated diseases.

pmid_database.title: Medicinal Properties of Cannabinoids, Terpenes, and Flavonoids in Cannabis, and Benefits in Migraine, Headache, and Pain: An Update on Current Evidence and Cannabis Science.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Comprehensive review of cannabinoids, terpenes, flavonoids for migraine, headache, and pain. Synergistic entourage effects. Cannabis may assist opioid detoxification. Individual medicinal properties of each compound reviewed. Supports strain-specific breeding.

pmid_database.title: The Therapeutic Potential of Cannabidiol in Skin Conditions.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of CBD in dermatology. Preclinical: promising for acne, psoriasis, dermatitis. Limited clinical evidence but multiple trials ongoing. CBD may improve skin hydration, elasticity, anti-aging. Multiple molecular skin targets identified.

pmid_database.title: Endocannabinoid signaling, glucocorticoid-mediated negative feedback, and regulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of ECS regulation of HPA axis. Endocannabinoids act in prefrontal cortex, amygdala, and hypothalamus to suppress HPA axis. Anandamide and 2-AG have distinct roles in basal, acute stress, and glucocorticoid feedback phases.

pmid_database.title: Early Phase in the Development of Cannabidiol as a Treatment for Addiction: Opioid Relapse Takes Initial Center Stage.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Translational review. CBD inhibits drug-seeking behavior, has low reinforcing properties, anxiolytic. Distinct from THC (rewarding, sensitizing). CBD investigations primarily in opioid drugs. Foundation for further exploration as opioid relapse treatment.

pmid_database.title: Cannabinoids and bone: friend or foe?
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of ECS in bone metabolism. CB1 deficiency: high peak bone mass but age-related osteoporosis. CB2 deficiency: increased bone turnover. GPR55 deficiency: increased bone mass. Cannabinoids in synovial tissue effective in inflammatory arthritis preclinical models.

pmid_database.title: Critical Aspects Affecting Cannabidiol Oral Bioavailability and Metabolic Elimination, and Related Clinical Implications.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: CBD oral bioavailability ~6% fasting; increases fourfold with high-fat meal. 70-75% of absorbed dose removed by first-pass hepatic metabolism. Improved formulations could increase absorption 4x. High hepatic clearance has DDI implications. Clinical variability concerns.

pmid_database.title: The cannabinoid CB2 receptor-selective phytocannabinoid beta-caryophyllene exerts analgesic effects in mouse models of inflammatory and neuropathic pain.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Oral BCP reduced inflammatory and neuropathic pain via CB2. Reduced spinal neuroinflammation. No tolerance after prolonged treatment. More effective than subcutaneous synthetic CB2 agonist. Natural dietary compound with pain-modulating potential.

pmid_database.title: The cannabinoid system and male reproductive functions.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of cannabinoid effects on male reproduction. Cannabis adversely affects hypothalamic-hypophyseal hormones and testicular function. Cannabinoids negatively influence sperm motility and acrosome reaction via CNR1 in mature sperm.

pmid_database.title: Hericium erinaceus: A possible future therapeutic treatment for the prevention and delayed progression of Alzheimer's disease? - A narrative review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 3 RCTs + 13 animal studies reviewed. HE demonstrated positive cognitive, histological, and biochemical outcomes. Erinacine-A enriched HE highest potency, crosses biological barriers. Evidence suggests HE may delay Alzheimer's progression.

pmid_database.title: Animal evidence considered in determination of cannabis smoke and delta-tetrahydrocannabinol as causing reproductive toxicity (developmental endpoint); Part II. Neurodevelopmental effects.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of animal studies on prenatal/perinatal THC exposure. Cognitive impairment, memory deficits, anxiety, increased drug sensitivity in offspring. Altered synaptic plasticity genes in nucleus accumbens. Cross-generational epigenetic effects. Basis for California Prop 65 listing.

pmid_database.title: Potential Anti-Rheumatoid Arthritis Activities and Mechanisms of Ganoderma lucidum Polysaccharides.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of Ganoderma lucidum polysaccharides (GLP) for RA. GLP inhibits synovial fibroblast proliferation, modulates inflammatory cytokines, reduces angiogenesis, protects cartilage and bone. Promising therapeutic agent for RA.

pmid_database.title: Emerging Perspectives in Addiction Psychiatry.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of addiction psychiatry perspectives. Psilocybin shows potential for depression, anxiety, alcohol use disorder, and opioid withdrawal symptom reduction. Comprehensive public health approach to SUD essential. FDA breakthrough therapy designation mentioned.

pmid_database.title: CBGA ameliorates inflammation and fibrosis in nephropathy.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: CBGA protects kidneys from cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity (CBD does not). CBGA suppresses inflammatory cytokines more effectively. Both reduce fibrosis in UUO chronic kidney model. CBGA inhibits TRPM7 channel-kinase. CBGA > CBD for kidney protection.

pmid_database.title: The Effects of Cannabinoids on Pro- and Anti-Inflammatory Cytokines: A Systematic Review of In Vitro Studies.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 26 in vitro studies. CBD, CBG, CBD+THC consistently reduced TNF-alpha, IL-1B, IL-6, IFN-gamma. THC alone did not reduce pro-inflammatory cytokines. CBD and CBG have predominantly anti-inflammatory profile. Informs future clinical trials.

pmid_database.title: Effect of combined doses of delta-tetrahydrocannabinol and cannabidiol or tetrahydrocannabinolic acid and cannabidiolic acid on acute nausea in male Sprague-Dawley rats.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Rat conditioned gaping model. CBDA+THCA at very low doses robustly reduce nausea via 5-HT1A and PPARα receptors. CBD+THC combination anti-nauseatic via 5-HT1A and CB1. Subthreshold combination doses more effective. Clinical trials warranted.

pmid_database.title: Acute Effects of Naturally Occurring Guayusa Tea and Nordic Lion's Mane Extracts on Cognitive Performance.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Double-blind RCT, single dose of 1g Lion's Mane. Improved working memory (N-Back reaction time), complex attention (Serial 7s), and Go stimulus reaction time at 2h post-ingestion. Improved subjective happiness ratings. Well tolerated.

pmid_database.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Ganoderma lucidum in Cancer.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Reishi ganoderic acid tested in 26 cancer cell types; anti-proliferative especially in leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma. Mechanisms: immune stimulation, MAP-K activation, apoptosis induction. In vivo: promotes T/B cell precursor differentiation and NK activity.

pmid_database.title: Benefits, side effects, and uses of Hericium erinaceus as a supplement: a systematic review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: PRISMA systematic review. 5 RCTs + 15 lab + 3 pilot trials. HE improved cognitive scores in dementia patients. Inhibited leukemia/gastric cancer cells. Increased gut SCFA bacteria, reduced inflammation. Enhanced BDNF, hippocampal neurogenesis. Reduced depression, anxiety, sleep disorders.

pmid_database.title: Neuroprotective properties of cannabigerol in Huntington's disease: studies in R6/2 mice and 3-nitropropionate-lesioned mice.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: CBG extremely active neuroprotectant in 3NP Huntington's mouse model. Improved motor deficits, preserved striatal neurons, reduced microgliosis, improved antioxidant levels. Partial recovery in R6/2 mice. BDNF, IGF-1, PPARy improved. Reduced mutant huntingtin aggregation.

pmid_database.title: Attenuation of early phase inflammation by cannabidiol prevents pain and nerve damage in rat osteoarthritis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: CBD decreased OA joint afferent firing rate and increased weight bearing dose-dependently. Acute joint inflammation reduced by CBD. Prophylactic CBD prevented development of OA pain and nerve damage. Neuroprotective effect at 5 weeks. Safe and useful for OA joint neuropathic pain.

pmid_database.title: Immunopharmacological Insights into Cordyceps spp.: Harnessing Therapeutic Potential for Sepsis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Cordyceps spp. contains nucleosides, sterols, flavonoids, phenolic compounds. Anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antibacterial, immunomodulatory, organ-protective in sepsis models. Protects brain, liver, kidneys, lungs, heart. Clinical trials still needed.

pmid_database.title: CB1-independent mechanisms of delta9-THCV, AM251 and SR141716 (rimonabant).
pmid_database.journal: Journal of Clinical Pharmacy and Therapeutics
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of CB1-independent mechanisms of THCV and related compounds. Effects in CB1-deficient cells, mu-opioid receptor affinity. Not purely CB1-selective. Important for understanding THCV pharmacotoxicology profile.

pmid_database.title: Non-psychoactive cannabinoids modulate the descending pathway of antinociception in anaesthetized rats through several mechanisms of action.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: CBD and CBC reduced ON neuron activity and produced antinociception in rat pain model. Effects via CB1, adenosine A1, and TRPA1 receptors (not TRPV1). Both elevated endocannabinoid levels. Multiple mechanisms support analgesic potential.

pmid_database.title: Hepatotoxicity of a Cannabidiol-Rich Cannabis Extract in the Mouse Model.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Mouse hepatotoxicity study. High-dose CBD (2460 mg/kg acute; 615 mg/kg sub-acute) caused liver weight increase, elevated ALT/AST/bilirubin. 75% of 615 mg/kg mice became moribund at day 3-4. Oxidative stress, lipid metabolism, CYP enzymes affected. Serious concerns about DDIs and safety at high doses.

pmid_database.title: Psilocybin-assisted psychotherapy for depression and anxiety associated with life threatening illness: A phase 2b randomized controlled trial.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Phase 2b RCT, 35 participants. Psilocybin 25mg vs niacin. Significant reductions in HADS depression, BDI-II and STAI-S anxiety at 6-7 weeks. Benefits sustained at 26 weeks. Enhanced spiritual wellbeing, QOL, reduced death anxiety and hopelessness. No serious adverse events.

pmid_database.title: Rapid and sustained symptom reduction following psilocybin treatment for anxiety and depression in patients with life-threatening cancer: a randomized controlled trial.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Crossover RCT, 29 cancer patients. Single-dose psilocybin vs niacin + psychotherapy. Significant immediate improvements in anxiety and depression. At 6.5-month follow-up, 60-80% sustained clinically significant reductions. Improved existential distress, QOL, attitudes toward death.

pmid_database.title: Dose-related effects of ketamine for antidepressant-resistant symptoms of posttraumatic stress disorder in veterans and active duty military: a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled multi-center clinical trial.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 158 veterans/military, multi-center RCT. Standard-dose ketamine (0.5 mg/kg) showed rapid antidepressant effect (MADRS) vs placebo. No significant dose-related PTSD symptom reduction. Dissociative effects returned to baseline in 2h. Well tolerated.

pmid_database.title: Efficacy, all-cause discontinuation, and safety of serotonergic psychedelics and MDMA to treat mental disorders: A living systematic review with meta-analysis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 30 RCTs, 1480 participants. MDMA for PTSD: SMD -0.85 (moderate certainty). Psilocybin/LSD for MDD: SMD -0.62. Anxiety disorders: moderate-large effects. Alcohol use disorder: no benefit. MDMA/psychedelics not associated with higher discontinuation rates.

pmid_database.title: Acute Adverse Effects of Therapeutic Doses of Psilocybin: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 6 studies, 528 participants. Headache, nausea, anxiety, dizziness, elevated BP all statistically significant vs placebo. All adverse effects tolerable and resolved within 48 hours. No significant risk of paranoia or thought disorder. Safety profile acceptable for therapeutic use.

pmid_database.title: Psychedelics as an intervention for psychological, existential distress in terminally ill patients: A systematic review and network meta-analysis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 9 RCTs, 606 participants. Psilocybin best for depression (NMA). LSD best for anxiety. Overall psychedelics effective for existential distress in terminal illness. Tolerability comparable. Head-to-head comparisons not statistically significant. More RCTs needed.

pmid_database.title: Positive expectations predict improved mental-health outcomes linked to psychedelic microdosing.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 81 participants, 4-week microdosing prospective study. Improved wellbeing, reduced anxiety and depression. Placebo response confirmed — positive expectancy at baseline predicted outcomes. Authors explicitly caution against overstating therapeutic value.

pmid_database.title: Emerging Perspectives in Addiction Psychiatry.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Review of addiction psychiatry. Psilocybin (FDA breakthrough therapy) potential for depression, anxiety, alcohol use disorder, and opioid withdrawal. Comprehensive public health approach needed. Most effective medications for AUD and OUD underutilized.

pmid_database.title: Benefits, side effects, and uses of Hericium erinaceus as a supplement: a systematic review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: PRISMA systematic review: 5 RCTs, 15 lab studies, 3 pilot trials. HE effective for neuroprotection, cognitive function, anti-tumor activity, gut health (SCFA bacteria), anxiety, depression, and sleep. Erinacines key bioactive. Side effects: stomach discomfort, headache, allergic reactions.

pmid_database.title: Hericium erinaceus: A possible future therapeutic treatment for the prevention and delayed progression of Alzheimer's disease? - A narrative review.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: 3 RCTs + 13 animal studies. HE demonstrates positive cognitive outcomes in humans and animal models. Erinacine-A enriched HE highest potency and crosses biological barriers. Evidence supports potential in delaying Alzheimer's progression.

pmid_database.title: Acute Effects of Naturally Occurring Guayusa Tea and Nordic Lion's Mane Extracts on Cognitive Performance.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Double-blind RCT crossover. Single 1g dose of Lion's Mane improved working memory, attention, reaction time at 2h. Improved happiness ratings. No blood pressure elevation (unlike guayusa). Acute cognitive benefit confirmed in healthy adults.

pmid_database.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Ganoderma lucidum in Cancer.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum) ganoderic acid anti-proliferative in 26 cancer cell types, especially leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma. Multiple mechanisms: immune stimulation, MAP-K, apoptosis. T/B cell differentiation, NK activity in in vivo model.

pmid_database.title: Potential Anti-Rheumatoid Arthritis Activities and Mechanisms of Ganoderma lucidum Polysaccharides.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: GLP inhibits RA synovial fibroblast proliferation, modulates inflammatory cytokines (TNF, IL-1B, IL-6), reduces angiogenesis (anti-VEGF), protects cartilage and bone. T/B cell and macrophage immunomodulation. Promising RA therapeutic.

pmid_database.title: Immunopharmacological Insights into Cordyceps spp.: Harnessing Therapeutic Potential for Sepsis.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Cordyceps spp. bioactive compounds (nucleosides, sterols, flavonoids, phenolics) have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antibacterial, immunomodulatory properties. Organ protective in brain, liver, kidneys, lungs, heart in sepsis models.

pmid_database.title: Animal evidence considered in determination of cannabis smoke and delta-THC as causing reproductive toxicity; Part II. Neurodevelopmental effects.
pmid_database.abstract_summary: Animal studies: prenatal THC exposure causes cognitive impairment, anxiety, drug sensitivity in offspring. Synaptic plasticity genes altered. Cross-generational epigenetic effects. ECS developmental context relevant to mushroom ECS interaction research.
